chunks: And Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan and Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥusayn both narrated to me from al-Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Mahziyār, from his father ‘Ali, from al-Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali ibn Faḍḍāl, from al-Ḥasan ibn al-Jahm ibn Bukayr, who said:
I mentioned it to Abī al-Ḥasan (peace be upon him), and he narrated the hadith in its entirety.
ai.seo_question: Where is the head of Imam al-Husain buried in relation to the body of Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This narration from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes the physical proximity of Imam ‘Ali’s grave and the head of al-Ḥusayn, a key site for Shia pilgrimage (ziyarat). It highlights the historical reunification of the head with the body in Kūfah, symbolizing the unity of the Imams' sacrifices and serving as a focal point for devotional visits to the Ahl al-Bayt.
